seo_title: Cost of Living in Larnaca 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Larnaca per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A coastal city in Cyprus with an international airport: a warm sea, English and Russian widely spoken, and cheaper than Limassol. Russian citizens need a visa; summers are hot and the beaches get crowded.
pros: International airport right in the city
Warm sea and a long beach season
cons: Russian citizens need a visa (Cyprus is outside Schengen but still requires one)
High prices for rent and groceries
Very hot and crowded in summer

visa_steps.title: Visa
visa_steps.description: Russians need a Cypriot visa (a pro-visa is issued online if you have grounds) or a Schengen visa.

visa_steps.title: Renting housing
visa_steps.description: Long-term rentals are pricier in summer; a lease is needed for the procedures that follow.

visa_steps.title: Registration (yellow slip)
visa_steps.description: For long stays you obtain a registration certificate.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Cypriot banks open accounts once you have an address and grounds to stay.

visa_steps.title: Residence permit (optional)
visa_steps.description: Through employment, business, a nomad visa or property.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Larnaca?
faq.answer: Yes, you need a Cypriot visa or a Schengen one — Cyprus requires a visa for Russians.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Larnaca?
faq.answer: High European prices, but cheaper than Limassol. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: What language is spoken in Larnaca?
faq.answer: Greek; English is everywhere, and there's a Russian-speaking community too.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Larnaca?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You need a foreign bank card or euros in cash.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Larnaca?
faq.answer: Mediterranean: hot, dry summers and mild winters — you can swim for half the year.

faq.question: Why is Larnaca more convenient than Limassol?
faq.answer: The airport is within the city, it's calmer and cheaper, yet the sea is just as warm.

reviews.text: Larnaca is handy with the airport right next door and an easy pace. It's expensive, especially rent, but the sea and safety are top-notch.
We moved over from Limassol — it's cheaper and quieter here, with the same beach. The main hassle for Russians is the visa and paperwork.
